title: MVP V4-2 core policy tx/account/snapshot model
brief: Implement the minimal consensus data model for V4 policies: dedicated PolicyTx with embedded PolicyAction, V4 INIT extension fields, compact account policy/finalization/rescue state, canonical signing/serde coverage, and snapshot/schema conversion. This slice must not implement the full evaluator or emergency routing behavior beyond model/storage invariants required by later sprints.

delegations.prompt_summary: Prepare a reuse map for V4-2 core policy model files, symbols, risks, and acceptance tests.

Implement V4-2 minimal consensus data model: PolicyTx with embedded PolicyAction, V4 INIT extension, account policy/rescue/finalized fields, snapshot conversion, signing/serde coverage, and policy reject mapping without evaluator/emergency routing behavior.
Fix V4-2 snapshot/types diagnostics: remove direct runtime Account.free_claim_utc_day references while preserving legacy wire field compatibility.
Second targeted fix-up: remove remaining `free_claim_utc_day: None` from runtime Account initializers in snapshot/types.rs while keeping legacy snapshot wire fields.
Validate V4-2 core model slice: PolicyTx/PolicyAction serde/signing, V4 INIT/account fields, snapshot legacy defaults, policy reject mapping, and compile checks.
Independent review of V4-2 core model implementation across tx/account/state/snapshot/API lifecycle artifacts.
Fix V4-2 review blocker: preserve Account.free_claim_utc_day across Account <-> SnapshotAccountWire/V2 conversions and add focused roundtrip test.
Retest V4-2 after free_claim_utc_day snapshot fix: focused roundtrip test, pwmd check, and pwm-core lib regression.
Re-review V4-2 after free_claim_utc_day snapshot fix.
Auto-close PASS_WITH_NITS: preserve non-empty cosigns in snapshot v2/wire conversion and add focused cosign roundtrip test; keep snapshot version additive.
Retest after cosigns snapshot conversion nit fix: cosign roundtrip, pwmd check, and free_claim roundtrip.
Final re-review after cosigns snapshot and info-map nit fixes.

notes: Simplicity constraints: one compact PolicyAction enum and one bounded Policy enum; no VM/DSL/dynamic dispatch; no separate tx type per policy; no self-transfer policy carrier. pwm-testing PASS used CARGO_TARGET_DIR=F:\pwm-test\pwm-protocol; initial full cargo test -p pwm-core/-p pwmd was not run, but targeted tests + cargo check + snapshot bench compile passed. Initial review REQUEST_CHANGES found loss of Account.free_claim_utc_day in snapshot conversion; pwm-coding fixed preservation and added acct_free_claim_day_rt. Retest PASS: acct_free_claim_day_rt, cargo check -p pwmd, cargo test -p pwm-core --lib (118 passed, 1 ignored). PASS_WITH_NITS auto-close added cosigns snapshot roundtrip and corrected info-map wording to additive snapshot v2.
